newsitem.title: USA: ConAgra to sell Country General Stores.
newsitem.headline: ConAgra to sell Country General Stores.

text.p: ConAgra Inc said Thursday it agreed to sell its Country General Store retail chain to Central Tractor Farm & Country as part of its strategy to divest non-core businesses.
Terms of the proposed transaction were not disclosed.
Country General Stores, based in Grand Island, Neb., operates 114 farm stores primarily in the Midwest. Annual sales are about $300 million.

"The sale of Country General is consistent with our announced commitment to divest non-core businesses and focus capital and management energy on ConAgra's core businesses," said Philip Fletcher, ConAgra chairman and chief executive officer, in a statement.
Central Tractor, based in Des Moines, Iowa, is an agricultural retailer of farming and gardening equipment.
